name: Weyrich et al. Splat Extent Calculation
aliases: Tight Axis-Aligned Bounding Rectangle for EWA Splatting
definition: A method to find screen-space position and extents by finding a plane in screen-space tangent to a quadric in parameter space (unit sphere), exploiting that normal vectors transform by the inverse transpose.
summary: Weyrich et al. Splat Extent Calculation computes tight axis-aligned bounding rectangles for EWA splats by avoiding explicit matrix inversions and conic transformations to ensure numerical stability.
